summary: Completed backend and frontend validation for Banque Misr bank-prints flow on public URL, including external fetch, pre-print save/archive, status updates, and read-only safeguards.
action_items: Clean test-created print requests containing note TEST_AUTOMATION_BANK_PRINT_DELETE_ME if production-like archive must stay clean.
Optional hardening: increase/handle Banque Misr external fetch timeout/retry path to reduce intermittent public-site dependency failures.
critical_code_review_comments: BanqueMisrPrintPage print template is built via string interpolation (document.write) using manual inputs; sanitize/escape all manual fields to avoid print-view HTML injection risk.
fetch_external_html uses single-shot urllib timeout=20 against public bank site; this may intermittently fail under slow upstream conditions.
backend/server.py remains very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk and reducing maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple bank print requests via API/UI for banque-misr; notes include TEST_AUTOMATION_BANK_PRINT_DELETE_ME.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest passed 4/4 for /api/bank-prints endpoints (external-data, create/archive/get, patch status, and no side-effect checks against journal-entries/reconciliations/banks opening balance). Playwright validated module-bank-prints-hub-card, /bank-prints portal scoping, /bank-prints/banque-misr external data + refresh, pre-print form save/print flow, archive review/reprint, and absence of accounting CRUD controls in Banque Misr prints page.
rca of the issue: No functional blocker found in requested scope. One initial Playwright failure was test-flow related (admin login lands on /secure-admin-control-panel by policy); resolved by routing back via admin-back-app-button before module checks.
